questions.question: Closing a plan must be refused for an approved plan directory unless its author wrote a short result section into the plan text, and the one-page summary produced when the plan is archived must repeat that section verbatim. In which functions of the script that archives and summarises plans must this be done, and which plan skeleton file must gain the new section?
questions.note: Task 7.1b, derived from merge a23c73279. git diff a23c73279^1 a23c73279: existing archive_plan and build_summary changed (plus new helpers); existing PLAN.template.md table row changed and a section added.

questions.question: The register of plans needs one more row status for a plan that was stopped on purpose (neither done nor archived). The per-plan check must also report a plan whose header status word is outside an agreed vocabulary, as an informational finding that never blocks. In the plans script, where are the row-status words, the set of non-blocking finding codes, and the per-plan check defined?
questions.note: Task 7.1b, derived from merge a23c73279. git diff a23c73279^1 a23c73279 -- scripts/plans_ledger.py: existing STATUSES (FROZEN added), NON_GATING_CODES (new code added) and check_plan_gate (header status finding added) changed.

Where is the set of recognised trailer names defined, and which routine runs the per-rule checks?
